title: Reconcile unicast-DIO admission gate vs unicast-DIS/join contract (7 tests red)
description: P1 from ba39 janitor run. worker-6's merged admission gate (85a1f1d218 + 3d104a10cd, spec 09 13.3 R-09-005, Python authenticated_dio.py:359-360 parity) admits ONLY canonical multicast DIOs: inner dst exactly ff02::1a, carried Rule 255, hop-limit 255. It rejects unicast-destination DIOs (worker6-dqeg rationale: unicast-addressed DIOs let a radio adversary mutate parent selection - in threat model). But main's tests + join helper still encode the old admissible-unicast-DIO contract: (a) rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs join_leaf helper (line ~657-671) delivers the root's DIO via sender.send_ipv6_to with unicast dst link_local_from_iid(leaf_addr) - fails 5 tests (leaf_send_allocates_each_update, dao_radio_failure_retains_exact_finalized_bytes, relay_forwards_original_source_and_signed_body, rpl_dispatch_rejects_invalid_ipv6_length_and_checksum, three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent); (b) multicast_dio_and_dis_are_received:1099 expects the unicast-DIS-triggered unicast DIO response (receive.rs:578 send_dio(source)) to be admitted; (c) routing::tests::nonzero_target_flags_dao_rejected_before_state_mutation fails separately with Malformed(InvalidOptionLength) at routing/tests.rs:2024 - DAO Target option length drift vs d5c4bb1e29 flags test (b7z9.3 thread). Fixed on main during ba39: RPL control now sends hop_limit 255 (623b13d54b) and canonical multicast DIOs are carried Rule 255 uncompressed (send_ipv6_uncompressed_to in stack.rs/secure.rs, transmit.rs send_dio) - multicast DIO phases pass. OPEN DECISION for worker-6 thread: does the leaf join via multicast-only DIO delivery (rewrite join helpers + receive.rs:578 unicast-DIS response), or does unicast DIO admission get a bounded authenticated contract?
